definitions.gloss: top floor; highest floor of a building
definitions.explanation: The highest floor of a building. Common in property listings, hotel descriptions, and directions inside department stores.

examples.japanese: {最上階|さいじょうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live on the top floor.

examples.japanese: {最上階|さいじょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The restaurant on the top floor has a good view.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{最上階|さいじょうかい}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: In this apartment building only the top floor has high ceilings, and the rent is a little higher too.

notes:
From ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧ (most) + ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upper) + ⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧ (floor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最上階|さいじょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a top-floor room
- {最上階|さいじょうかい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to go up to the top floor
- ⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最上階|さいじょうかい}: the top floor of the building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋上|おくじょう}→屋上：01341_okujou⟧: rooftop — the open roof above the top floor, not a floor with rooms
- {最下階|さいかかい}: bottom floor — the opposite, though ⟦{一階|いっかい}→一階：27512_ikkai⟧ or ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧ is more usual in speech
